mapper.select: SELECT * FROM WALLET_REWARD_POLICY ORDER BY event_type ASC, FIELD(member_grade, 'ALL','BRONZE','SILVER','GOLD','DIAMOND','PLATINUM'), member_grade
SELECT * FROM WALLET_REWARD_POLICY WHERE is_active = 1 AND event_type = #{eventType} AND (member_grade = #{memberGrade} OR member_grade = 'ALL') ORDER BY (member_grade = 'ALL') ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: INSERT INTO WALLET_REWARD_POLICY (event_type, member_grade, reward_type, reward_rate, reward_fixed, description, is_active, updated_by_user_idx) VALUES (#{eventType}, #{memberGrade}'ALL', #{rewardType}, #{rewardRate}, #{rewardFixed}, #{description}, #{isActive}, #{updatedByUserIdx}) AS new_row ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE reward_type = new_row.reward_type, reward_rate = new_row.reward_rate, reward_fixed = new_row.reward_fixed, description = new_row.description, is_active = new_row.is_active, updated_by_user_idx = new_row.updated_by_user_idx
